messages:
maria: @here quick heads-up — onboarding/faststart.md has a diagram image returning 403 (S3). Ran kb-scan at 08:12 and it flagged the asset: https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-assets/onboard/diagram.png :eyes:
alex: I can take a look. Prob ACL or accidental bucket policy change. @maria can you paste the object key so I can run a quick check?
maria: object key is `onboard/diagram.png` in bucket `redwood-assets`
docs-bot: kb-scan summary: 1 asset 403 in path `onboarding/faststart.md` — created ticket DOCS-483 (auto)
alex: quick diagnostic command to run locally if needed:
```
aws s3api get-object-acl --bucket redwood-assets --key onboard/diagram.png
```
If ACLs are fine, we should rehost on CDN; otherwise set correct ACL + rehost as a durable fix. Prefer rehost + update shortlink. :wrench:
ryan: I can claim the PR to rehost. @maria can you open a tiny PR that replaces the S3 URL with `/assets/onboard/diagram.png` (served from CDN)? I'll review and do backports.
tina: heads-up — there are localized docs (ja, es) that include the same image path. Please add backport checklist in the PR so we don't forget translations.
maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7245 — replaces S3 URL with CDN shortlink and adds a checklist for ja/es backports. Also added a note on DOCS-483 with the steps taken.
alex: LGTM on approach. I'll run the ACL check and, if necessary, set a temporary redirect while PR merges. Will add a short S3 policy comment to the ticket. :thumbsup:
sophia (Product): quick FYI — I'm out until tomorrow morning but UX team confirmed this change shouldn't affect onboarding flow. No further product review needed unless something visual breaks.
ryan: I'll do the backports after merge, ETA today EOD. If CI blocks me I'll ping here.
maria: assigning DOCS-483 to ryan and tagging the PR in the ticket. Thanks everyone — small change but high impact for new signups. :tada:
